name: Cannoli Latte
caffeineNote: Label states 200 mg; brand notes contents may vary
summary: Cannoli-flavored latte on reduced-fat milk at a label-printed 200 mg of caffeine per 11 oz can, with 16 g of sugar (only 5 g of it added, alongside sucralose) and 7 g of protein at 140 calories. This is Bones' flavored-latte line: their Holy Cannoli Cold Brew Latte is a separate, stronger and sweeter can.
